arms.baseline_only: when a fixture has no coverage-on arm yet, each slot runs the off arm alone; results are baselines, never overhead evidence
arms.pairing: one slot runs both arms on the same host, build, fixture, toolchain revision, and corpus version

invalidation.retained: every invalid run stays in the raw results with its reason

measurement.memory: child maximum resident set size from wait4, normalized to bytes
measurement.wall_time: from process spawn to reaped exit, including interpreter or loader startup

ordering.rule: slot k (0-based, warmup included) runs off then on when k is even and on then off when k is odd
